messages:
mike: CI is failing for the sampleapp onboarding after a typegen regen — auth/retry tests blow up with a typehash mismatch. anyone else seeing this?

build-bot: CI job sampleapp-onboard #4821 failed · logs: https://ci.redwood/example/4821 · exit 1

toni: on it. did we flip the openapi property sorter last night? i merged a small change that touched ordering but thought it was deterministic.

sana: i noticed enum -> example ordering changed in one regen locally. could be nondeterministic sorting in one of the codegen passes. snippet: 
```
- typehash: "abc123"
+ typehash: "def456"
```

mike: that typehash is the semver guard one — it should only change if shape changed. nothing in our spec adds/renames fields.

jen: could regen be picking up example-only properties from the fixtures? we've seen that cause spurious diffs before.

eric: i can repro locally, looks like the property list iteration order differs when map insertion order varies across Go versions. openapi-sorter wasn't stable.

sana: workaround: pin typegen in the sampleapp to v2.14.3 so the CI uses the previous generator until we fix. @mike can you try pinning and re-run? :eyes:

mike: pinned typegen to v2.14.3 in sampleapp/ci config and requeued job. still failing, uploading full log to the thread.

mike: log: 
``
FAIL auth_retry_test.go: expected typehash abc123, got def456
Regenerated client at /tmp/out; diff shows property order change on /schemas/Policy
```

toni: ok i'm prepping a patch to force deterministic sort in the openapi codegen (sort by (required, name) then stable). will push branch openapi/deterministic-sort and trigger CI.

build-bot: Build queued: openapi/deterministic-sort #79

jen: heads up — changing sorter may bump typehash legitimately. we should record the change in the changelog and decide semver policy (do we treat this as internal tooling fix or API shape change?).

eric: it's an internal generator determinism fix — no surface API change. add changelog note: 'fix(codegen): deterministic property sorting to stabilize generated clients'. mark as internal.

mike: thanks — i'll update onboarding docs mentioning short-term pin and add a note to the sampleapp README about regen expectations.

sana: adding a unit test to catch typehash flips for sampleapp fixtures so future regens fail fast in CI.

toni: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/856 — forces deterministic sort and adds a test. reviewers welcome. :mag:

jen: reviewed +1, ran the quick script locally, no diffs now. :thumbsup:

build-bot: Build passed: sampleapp-onboard #4822 :tada:

mike: awesome — merging the patch and will cut a tiny internal release note for the regen tooling fix. will unpin typegen in sampleapp after the release. thanks everyone. :party:
